title: Registry Party Credit on Extra Fittings — Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry Consultant Q&A
content:
Registrants with the Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry receive a wedding-party credit, taken off a Marlowe & Finch Alterations extra fitting fee:

| The customer's registries | Wedding-party credit |
|---|---|
| An active Wedding Registry whose event date is today or later | 4.00 USD |
| No such Wedding Registry, and an active Anniversary Registry or an active Celebration Registry | 2.00 USD |
| Anything else | none |

**Records read.** The registry type, status and event date of each of the customer's Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry registries.

## Questions answered by the rule

**The customer's active Wedding Registry had its event last month, and the customer also holds an active Anniversary Registry.** The Wedding Registry's event date is not today or later, so there is no such Wedding Registry; the active Anniversary Registry gives 2.00 USD.

**The customer's active Wedding Registry has its event today.** Today counts as today or later: 4.00 USD.

**The customer holds only an active Baby Registry.** Neither line applies: none.

**The customer holds an active Celebration Registry and an active Wedding Registry with its event next year.** The Wedding Registry line applies: 4.00 USD.
